question: List the building names, names of HR departments occupying them, the total gross square footage, the total and average assignable square footage, and the built year per building key.
statements:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE buildings_master AS
SELECT 
  building_key,
  building_number,
  building_name,
  bldg_gross_square_footage,
  bldg_assignable_square_footage
FROM beaver.buildings

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE rooms_space_assignments AS
WITH z AS (
  SELECT 
    z.building_room,
    CAST(z.hr_org_unit_id AS BIGINT) AS hr_org_unit_id,
    z.floor,
    z.building_component
  FROM beaver.zpm_rooms_load z
), sd AS (
  SELECT 
    s.building_room,
    s.building_key,
    s.room_square_footage AS area,
    s.floor_key,
    s.building_component
  FROM beaver.space_detail s
)
SELECT 
  sd.building_key AS building_key,
  z.building_room AS building_room,
  fr.space_id AS space_id,
  z.hr_org_unit_id AS hr_org_unit_id,
  sd.area AS area
FROM z
JOIN sd
  ON sd.building_room = z.building_room
LEFT JOIN beaver.fac_rooms fr
  ON fr.building_key = sd.building_key
  AND fr.room_full_name = z.building_room

SELECT 
  CAST(hr_org_unit_id AS BIGINT) AS hr_org_unit_id,
  hr_org_unit_title,
  hr_department_name
FROM beaver.hr_org_unit_new

  CAST(bldg_gross_square_footage AS DOUBLE) AS bldg_gross_square_footage,
  CAST(bldg_assignable_square_footage AS DOUBLE) AS bldg_assignable_square_footage
FROM beaver.buildings

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "hr_org_units" AS SELECT 
  CAST(hr_org_unit_id AS BIGINT) AS hr_org_unit_id,
  CAST(hr_org_unit_title AS VARCHAR) AS hr_org_unit_title,
  CAST(hr_department_name AS VARCHAR) AS hr_department_name
FROM beaver.hr_org_unit_new

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH room_enriched AS (
    SELECT 
        r.building_key,
        COALESCE(r.hr_org_unit_id, hun.hr_org_unit_id) AS hr_org_unit_id,
        COALESCE(sd.room_square_footage, r.area) AS area
    FROM rooms_space_assignments r
    LEFT JOIN space_detail sd
      ON sd.building_room = r.building_room
    LEFT JOIN hr_org_units hun
      ON hun.hr_org_unit_id = r.hr_org_unit_id
), hr_only AS (
    -- Filter to HR-related org units by name contains 'Human Resources' or 'HR'
    SELECT re.building_key, re.area, hun.hr_org_unit_title, hun.hr_department_name
    FROM room_enriched re
    LEFT JOIN hr_org_units hun ON hun.hr_org_unit_id = re.hr_org_unit_id
    WHERE (
        LOWER(COALESCE(hun.hr_org_unit_title, '')) LIKE '%human resources%'
        OR LOWER(COALESCE(hun.hr_department_name, '')) LIKE '%human resources%'
        OR REGEXP_MATCHES(LOWER(COALESCE(hun.hr_org_unit_title, '')), '(^|[^a-z])hr([^a-z]|$)')
        OR REGEXP_MATCHES(LOWER(COALESCE(hun.hr_department_name, '')), '(^|[^a-z])hr([^a-z]|$)')
    )
), agg AS (
    SELECT 
        b.building_key,
        b.building_name,
        SUM(DISTINCT b.bldg_gross_square_footage) AS total_gross_sqft,
        SUM(DISTINCT b.bldg_assignable_square_footage) AS total_building_assignable_sqft,
        COALESCE(SUM(h.area), 0) AS total_hr_assignable_sqft,
        CASE WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN h.area IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) > 0 
             THEN AVG(h.area) 
             ELSE NULL END AS avg_hr_assignable_sqft
    FROM buildings_master b
    LEFT JOIN hr_only h ON h.building_key = b.building_key
    GROUP BY b.building_key, b.building_name
), dept_list AS (
    SELECT 
        h.building_key,
        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(h.hr_org_unit_title, h.hr_department_name,'')), ''), 'Unknown'), ', ') AS hr_departments
    FROM hr_only h
    GROUP BY h.building_key
)
SELECT 
    a.building_key,
    a.building_name,
    dl.hr_departments,
    a.total_gross_sqft,
    a.total_building_assignable_sqft AS total_assignable_sqft,
    a.total_hr_assignable_sqft,
    a.avg_hr_assignable_sqft,
    NULL AS built_year
FROM agg a
LEFT JOIN dept_list dl ON dl.building_key = a.building_key
WHERE a.total_hr_assignable_sqft > 0
ORDER BY a.building_key
LIMIT 100
